definitions.title: The Mudking
definitions.body: The Mudking bars the path. Behind him, a captive merchant calls from a crooked cage. Mudking says the road and everyone on it belong to him.

choices.label: Challenge the Mudking
choices.response: Mudking raises his club and stomps into the clearing.

definitions.title: The Merchant Is Free
definitions.body: Mudking falls. He grumbles that the cage key is under his throne, and the merchant calls out for help.

choices.label: Free the merchant
choices.response: You open the cage. The merchant thanks the warband and promises to bring a Shop to Camp.

definitions.title: The Mudking Returns
definitions.body: Mudking recognizes the warband. The merchant is safe in Camp now, but Mudking still claims the road as his own.

choices.label: Challenge him again
choices.response: Mudking grips his club and calls for another fight.
